reviews.title: elite modular case / rugged / flight — the thread

pull.q: A compact solution for traveling performers and artists who need an abundance of rack space and the highest level of protection.

quotes.t: This rugged design is sleek and easy to carry, complying with most airline carry-on requirements, and sturdy enough to keep up with even the most demanding touring situations with ease.
The inside clearance of the clamshell design is over 2", allowing for a full patch on each system to be closed inside the case.
